name: MirageOS
description:
MirageOS is a Flash Application Shell that has revolutionized the TI-83 Plus with its many built-in features for the User and the Assembly Programmer.

Review by Ben F:
Mirage OS is one of the best shells for the Ti-83+/TI-84+. It works on all 83+/84+ calcs regardless of age, and runs programs with little issue.

The only real problem I have is that the options menus are a bit obtuse to new users.

While many say that this program has been made irrelevant by 'DoorsCS7', I believe it offers a worthy alternative for calcs with warped displays or for people who just want a simple, archive compatible shell.

This gets a 9.1/10.
author: Dan Englender and Jason Kovacs
